headlines.title: 蓝佛安：精准有效实施更加积极的财政政策
headlines.summary: 财政部党组书记、部长蓝佛安在求是杂志发文称，今年是“十五五”开局之年，做好接下来几个月工作对完成全年目标任务、实现良好开局至关重要。更加注重扩大国内有效需求，保持经济平稳运行。合理加快支出进度，对于支出进度偏慢的地区加强督促指导、打通堵点，让宝贵的财政资金早落地、早见效。统筹用好超长期特别国债、地方政府专项债券等资金，扎实推进“六张网”和“两重”建设。优化实施财政金融协同促内需政策，扩大贴息范围，增加经办机构，适当提高额度，更好释放消费潜力、撬动民间投资。发行3000亿元特别国债支持有关中央金融企业补充核心一级资本，巩固提升其稳健经营和服务实体经济能力。

headlines.title_en: Lan Fo'an: Precisely and effectively implement a more proactive fiscal policy
headlines.summary_en: Lan Fo'an, Party Secretary and Minister of Finance, wrote in Qiushi magazine that this year is the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, and doing a good job in the coming months is crucial to completing the full-year targets and achieving a good start. Greater emphasis should be placed on expanding effective domestic demand and keeping the economy running smoothly. Reasonably accelerate the pace of spending, strengthen supervision and guidance for regions with slow spending progress, clear bottlenecks, and ensure that precious fiscal funds are deployed and take effect early. Coordinate the use of ultra-long special government bonds, local government special bonds and other funds to solidly advance the "six networks" and "two heavy" construction. Optimize and implement fiscal-financial coordination policies to boost domestic demand, expand the scope of interest subsidies, increase handling institutions, appropriately raise quotas, and better unleash consumption potential and leverage private investment. Issue 300 billion yuan in special government bonds to support relevant central financial enterprises in replenishing core tier-one capital, consolidating and enhancing their ability to operate steadily and serve the real economy.

headlines.title: 国家外汇管理局：上半年，我国经常账户顺差3780亿美元
headlines.summary: 国家外汇管理局日前发布的《2026年上半年中国国际收支报告》显示，上半年，我国经常账户收支总额为4.6万亿美元，同比增长16%；经常账户顺差3780亿美元，与国内生产总值（GDP）比值保持稳定。在货物贸易方面，上半年，国际收支口径的货物进出口总额同比增长18%，人工智能、绿色能源等相关贸易表现突出。货物进口同比增长近20%，较出口增速快2.3个百分点。在服务贸易方面，上半年，服务贸易出口同比增长21%，外籍人员来华旅行增多、新兴生产性服务贸易出口加快分别贡献服务出口增长的16%和42%。服务贸易进口同比增长7%，我国仍是全球主要服务贸易进口国。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: State Administration of Foreign Exchange: In the first half of the year, China's current account surplus was $378 billion
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange recently released the "China International Balance of Payments Report for the First Half of 2026," showing that in the first half, China's current account receipts and payments totaled 4.6 trillion US dollars, up 16% year-on-year; the current account surplus was 378 billion US dollars, with its ratio to gross domestic product (GDP) remaining stable. In goods trade, in the first half, the total goods import and export volume under the balance of payments basis rose 18% year-on-year, with trade related to artificial intelligence and green energy performing notably well. Goods imports rose nearly 20% year-on-year, 2.3 percentage points faster than export growth. In services trade, in the first half, services exports rose 21% year-on-year, with increased foreign travel to China and accelerated exports of emerging producer services contributing 16% and 42% of services export growth respectively. Services imports rose 7% year-on-year, and China remains a major global services trade importer. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 财政部部长蓝佛安《求是》撰文：精准有效实施更加积极的财政政策
headlines.summary: 财政部部长蓝佛安《求是》撰文，财政是国家治理的基础和重要支柱。财政政策作为宏观调控的重要手段，具有扩大总需求和定向调结构的双重优势。“十四五”以来，我国财政政策始终保持积极取向，并根据形势变化适时调整完善，不断增强与经济运行的适配性，有力支撑了经济平稳健康发展。今年以来，面对国内外复杂环境带来的困难挑战，财政部门坚决落实党中央和国务院决策部署，牢牢把握高质量发展这个首要任务，扎实实施更加积极的财政政策，着力稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期，着力推改革、强管理、防风险、增效益，促进经济实现质的有效提升和量的合理增长。

headlines.title_en: Finance Minister Lan Fo'an writes in Qiushi: Precisely and effectively implement a more proactive fiscal policy
headlines.summary_en: Finance Minister Lan Fo'an wrote in Qiushi that finance is the foundation and an important pillar of national governance. As an important means of macroeconomic regulation, fiscal policy has the dual advantages of expanding aggregate demand and targeted structural adjustment. Since the 14th Five-Year Plan, China's fiscal policy has consistently maintained a proactive orientation and been adjusted and improved in light of changing conditions, continuously enhancing its compatibility with economic operations and strongly supporting steady and healthy economic development. Since the beginning of this year, facing difficulties and challenges brought by the complex domestic and international environment, the finance department has resolutely implemented the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, firmly grasped the primary task of high-quality development, solidly implemented a more proactive fiscal policy, focused on stabilizing employment, enterprises, markets and expectations, and focused on advancing reform, strengthening management, preventing risks and increasing efficiency, promoting both qualitative improvement and reasonable quantitative growth of the economy.

headlines.summary_en: [In the first half of this year, China's total current account receipts and payments rose 16% year-on-year] The State Administration of Foreign Exchange recently released the "China International Balance of Payments Report for the First Half of 2026," showing that in the first half, China's current account receipts and payments totaled 4.6 trillion US dollars, up 16% year-on-year; the current account surplus was 378 billion US dollars, with its ratio to gross domestic product (GDP) remaining stable.

headlines.title_en: Report: Vale considers first panda bond issuance, seeking to raise no more than 3.5 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: According to people familiar with the matter, Brazilian iron ore giant Vale is considering issuing bonds in China's domestic market for the first time, raising no more than 3.5 billion yuan, joining a growing number of issuers seeking to diversify funding sources and reduce financing costs. The company plans to hold a roadshow for the "panda bond" issuance in the week of October 19 and aims to begin issuance marketing as early as November. The bond tenor may be 3, 5 or 10 years, with the final tenor to be determined based on investor feedback. The panda bonds will be issued by Vale's subsidiary Vale Overseas Limited and guaranteed by the parent company. (Bloomberg

headlines.title_en: US Democratic lawmakers question legality of Pentagon plan to take a stake in a Venezuelan oil company
headlines.summary_en: According to The Wall Street Journal, Democratic senators in the US Senate are questioning whether the Pentagon's plan to take a stake in a Venezuelan oil company is legal and prudent. Four senior Senate Democrats said in a letter to a senior Trump aide that the Pentagon's proposed stake in North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) has unstable legal footing and undermines Venezuela's efforts to promote a democratic transition. In early September, the United States announced a plan for the Pentagon to passively hold a 35% stake in NABEP. The company would gain control of 17 oil field blocks related to Venezuela's second-largest oil producer, which are said to contain about 65 billion barrels of oil reserves. As part of the arrangement, the US State Department would obtain priority rights to purchase 20% of output at cost. The lawmakers demanded that the Trump administration publish the agreement before the deal is finalized

headlines.title_en: South Korea's exports grow strongly, with export value topping $800 billion for the first time in the first nine months
headlines.summary_en: South Korea's September exports extended strong growth, with global AI demand continuing to drive semiconductor exports, leading the market to expect that this heavily trade-dependent economy will remain resilient despite rising interest rates. Data released by Korea Customs on Thursday showed that, adjusted for working days, South Korea's September exports rose 104.9% year-on-year. Korea Customs said that in the first nine months of 2026, South Korea's exports reached 814.5 billion US dollars, surpassing the 800 billion US dollar mark for the first time and hitting a record high. The chip boom is also changing the South Korean government's fiscal position. South Korea expects national tax revenue to reach a record 478.6 trillion won (about 353 billion US dollars) this year, up 28% from 2025, mainly driven by semiconductor company profits, special dividends from chip companies, active stock markets and a consumption recovery.
